d6.finding: GET /api/v1/ingestion/cases/{caseId}/recipes/{recipeId} returns a streamed recipe at runtime: the streamed author and approve write every revision to usp_mapping_recipe_revisions (packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/streamed-mapping.ts:104-106, 142-145) and the history read returns those bodies unparsed (service.ts:244-247). Its published response type is z.array(AnyMappingReceiptSchema), manual and tabular receipts only (apps/api/src/modules/ingestion/ingestion.controller.ts:127), so the Studio widens its Recipe type to include the streamed receipt (apps/studio/src/features/intake/layout-model.ts:7-10) and the review reads the streamed plan.
d6.approval: LayoutReview's approval of a streamed receipt goes to .../streamed-profile/jobs/{jobId}/recipes/{recipeId}/approve, chosen by the receipt's plan version in useLayoutCommand.ts.

leadNotes: The streamed author checks plan.caseRevision against the profile job's input case revision (streamed-mapping.ts:68), which no route publishes. D3's pin (the current case revision, as runtime.ts reads it) matches only while the case has not advanced since the profile was queued; otherwise the server answers 409 'The source case revision changed.' and the officer cannot author until it is published.
